Oil Futures End Volatile Session Near Flat

Brent crude for January delivery ticked up to $91.98 a barrel, while WTI crude for December delivery slipped 0.1% to $83.21

By

and

Oil futures were little changed Thursday at the end of a session of ups and downs as renewed concerns about possible escalation in the Middle East are tempered by improving global supply.

Brent crude for January delivery gained three cents to $91.98 a barrel. West Texas Intermediate crude for December delivery slipped 0.1% to $83.21 ahead of Friday’s contract expiry.
